coverage: The 2026 release reflects the five-province, 42-commune reform. Its third level contains 451 zones and 11 protected-area reference pieces, not 462 administrative zones. Local areas are clipped to their displayed parent and residual source gaps are reconciled within that parent. Inland lake water is excluded; coastlines have no border stroke. Population is not inferred by distributing national totals.
processing: Retained source bytes are verified by SHA-256. Administrative polygons are cleaned together at 0.00012-degree simplification; Maldives island footprints retain government source resolution. Complete neighboring outline arcs share projected endpoints and previously established junctions. Local areas are clipped individually on a mic degree lattice, with source gaps assigned within their displayed parent. Lake masks preserve the 56 mapped Lake Tana islands. Coastlines have no border stroke. Only selected-parent local geometry loads.

populationCoverage.method: Only verified source identities and dated observations are assigned. Rwanda uses the NISR 2022 census; the inconsistent COD-PS 2023 provincial totals are not used. No older Burundi province population is transferred to the new five provinces. National GDP is never allocated to subdivisions.
